services.name: Kona Fishing Charters
services.desc: If your time is limited the shorter trip will provide you with an exciting sport fishing adventure that will fit into your schedule! The longer trips can experience the most tide changes and allow Capt. Borges to fish the greatest area of the Kona waters to maximize your catching potential! Trips usually depart at 6:30 am. However, depending on fishing conditions, an earlier departure may be recommended to optimize your fishing experience. Please coordinate directly with Capt. blurb: Guests fish for big-game fish including trophy blue marlin aboard a 38' Buddy Davis sport fishing boat. The boat is equipped for rough water sport-fishing with a live-well, fish box, fighting chair, and comfortable fly-bridge seating. The interior includes air conditioning, galley, salon, and entertainment systems for guest comfort.
